name: skills-janitor
tagline_zh: 你的Claude Code技能库像衣柜塞满旧T恤？用Tinder式左滑右滑清理无用技能，扫描提示注入。
tagline_en: Tinder for your Claude Code skills. Swipe left on context-wasters, scan for prompt injection, see honest token.
desc_en: Tinder for your Claude Code skills. Swipe away what wastes context, scan for prompt injection, get honest token costs. 6 commands, zero dependencies, Claude Code + Codex.
why_zh: 同类工具只列清单，它让你像刷交友软件一样决策，还自带安全扫描，把token成本摊开给你看。
why_en: Unlike list-based cleaners, it makes you swipe decisions, scans for injection, and shows real token costs per skill.
